"""Record a human viewing event only after the assistant has actually seen it."""

import argparse
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('sheets', help='Comma-separated sheet numbers actually seen')
parser.add_argument('notes')
args = parser.parse_args()
root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v3')
manifest = read(root / 'figures-v1.json')
journal = root / 'native-viewing-session-v1.jsonl'
events = [json.loads(line) for line in journal.read_text().splitlines()] if journal.exists() else []
seen = {number for event in events for number in event['sheets']}
selected = [int(number) for number in args.sheets.split(',')]
assert not seen.intersection(selected) and len(set(selected)) == len(selected)
assert all(0 <= number < len(manifest['sheets']) for number in selected)
for number in selected:
    sheet = manifest['sheets'][number]
    assert ref(sheet['image']['path']) == sheet['image'] and sheet['no_resize']
event = {'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(), 'sheets': selected,
         'detail': 'original', 'notes': args.notes}
with journal.open('a') as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(event) + '\n')
events.append(event)
seen.update(selected)
print('Recorded actual viewing:', selected, '; total', len(seen))
if len(seen) == 18:
    assert seen == set(range(18)) and len(manifest['images']) == 72
    indices = [i for n in sorted(seen) for i in manifest['sheets'][n]['indices']]
    assert sorted(indices) == list(range(72)) and len(indices) == len(set(indices))
    save(root / 'native-viewing-v1.json', {
        'status': 'actually-viewed-all72-native-primary-figures-at-original-detail',
        'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(), 'figure_manifest': ref(root / 'figures-v1.json'),
